decisive_items: non-pitting edema of the left periorbital region
numerous dermal ectatic blood vessels and lymphatics
response.rationale: C1 combines the biopsy finding of ectatic lymphatics with the periorbital location, providing the most specific and complete diagnosis. R4 lacks the anatomical modifier, while other candidates are contradicted by the biopsy or clinical course.

rejected.why: Biopsy shows ectatic lymphatics, not typical of angioedema; no response to antihistamines and negative patch test argue against allergic angioedema.
No sicca symptoms or visual symptoms; persistent unilateral swelling is not characteristic of Sjögren syndrome.
Isolated periorbital lymphedema is less likely; biopsy findings are more consistent with lymphangioma.
Biopsy findings do not support scleroderma; no skin thickening or systemic features.
